d: The Pentagon is turning to America's automotive giants in a bid to ramp up military drone production. General Motors, Ford and other manufacturers are reportedly in talks to help supply components such as engines, sensors, actuators and lidar to drone makers. As unmanned systems become increasingly important in modern warfare, Washington is looking to harness Detroit's mass-production expertise and strengthen America's defence supply chain.
